title: Security Event Log
description: Stops an account takeover hiding among routine entries: risky changes from other devices are highlighted, and a burst of them (a new device, then 2-step verification off, then a new recovery email) is grouped and named as a likely takeover, every row has a "This wasn't me" path that lists each step it will take (sign the device out, turn 2-step back on, restore recovery details...) as a checkbox the user can untick before it acts, and days and times follow the account's time zone with relative time.
stops: Account takeover buried in the activity log
